free_tier.stated: True pay-as-you-go pricing on multi-node clusters.

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: Provision and manage with a UI console, Terraform, SDK and API; the inference gateway uses an OpenAI-compatible API.
tooling: the user installs and runs Terraform or an SDK against the Verda API; the console manages deployments without installed tooling
chaining: GPU instances, CPU instances, instant clusters, serverless containers and storage are all priced on one page; spot is a discount off the paid on-demand rate and reserved terms run from one month to two years

limits.value: priced per GPU-hour on instances, clusters and serverless containers, with no commitment and no minimum on pay-as-you-go; reserved discounts run from 1 month to 2 years

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: Sign in with Google, Microsoft or GitHub, or with email and password; the console is protected by reCAPTCHA. No card or phone number is stated on the sign-in page.

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-22 and states the pay-as-you-go model per GPU. There is no free tier, so the verdict moves to paid-only
